integrity: All finite-field arithmetic, generator-polynomial reconstruction, complete message enumeration, projective column multiplicities, line incidences, and generalized Hamming weights are replayed exactly by the bundled standard-library verifier.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to the admissible \(q=23,n=24\) specialization and the three dimension-\(4\) members. It does not classify all cyclic codes with the same parameters. Complete publisher full text was not obtainable, so an unindexed prior computation remains a residual literature risk.
title: The three dimension-\(4\) \([24,4,12]_{23}\) members have distinct spectra and support hierarchies
